{"title":"Echoes of the Borderlands","entries":[{"region_id":"R00","text":"Hearthfield
The old road bends around a hearthstone. Its inscription offers no command: rest, eat, and choose a path when morning comes."},{"region_id":"R01","text":"Briarford
Toren keeps the watch beside cottages rebuilt from storm-felled timber. Every repaired shield carries a different traveler’s mark."},{"region_id":"R02","text":"Emberwick
Ira plants bright berries between herb beds. The village remembers winter by the gardens that survived it."},{"region_id":"R03","text":"Mossveil
Woodcutters leave the oldest pines standing. The moss beneath them records a quieter history than the roads."},{"region_id":"R04","text":"Stormstone
The abandoned quarry supplied the crown’s observatory. Its last stone was never carried down the ridge."},{"region_id":"R05","text":"Crownfall
A broken arch points toward no throne. The royal scribes hid their records among ordinary stones when the banners fell."},{"region_id":"R06","text":"Oathkeeper
The grove’s promise was made to living travelers, not kings. A pilgrim may read the runes once; their meaning belongs to memory."},{"region_id":"R07","text":"Moonwell
Dry paths wind between pools that reflect the sky. The forgotten well held maps of journeys that had not yet begun."}]}
